description: Editable editorial choices, not empirically calibrated relationship statistics.

synastry_prompts.conjunction: Discuss where your priorities overlap and where each person needs room.
synastry_prompts.sextile: Look for a small shared activity that helps you support each other.
synastry_prompts.square: Compare expectations openly and choose one practical compromise.
synastry_prompts.trine: Notice what feels easy between you, and make time to appreciate it.
synastry_prompts.opposition: Name both perspectives before deciding how to balance them.

transit_prompts.conjunction: Choose one intention and give it your attention.
transit_prompts.sextile: Consider a small constructive step you can take today.
transit_prompts.square: Pause before reacting and check what you actually need.
transit_prompts.trine: Make room for an activity that already feels natural to you.
transit_prompts.opposition: Balance your own priorities with another point of view.
